title: From Silos to Systems: Process-Oriented Hazard Analysis for AI Systems
reasoning: The paper focuses on a hazard analysis framework (PHASE) to identify sociotechnical and performance-based harms in AI systems. While it references the 'Fairness, Accountability, Transparency and Ethics' (FATE) community and includes a section on Ethical Considerations, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, spiritual traditions, or specific moral/ethical systems as a core component of its research.
